approved_divergences: GooseLake has an independent authority store and provider adapters, not the Golden Goose desktop runtime.
GooseLake supports ACP; Golden Goose also has other provider implementations that are not automatically in scope.
GooseLake's model-facing gg_message uses a top-level mode and its own cross-workspace runtime trust-domain rules.
GooseLake retains legacy operator split MCP tools until the separately gated irreversible cutover; scoped provider tools are exactly three.
GooseLake's context observations require an exact session/agent revision and transactional freshness check; fields matching Golden Goose do not certify identical recovery semantics.
